This notebook follows the preprocessing plan in `data_preprocess.md` to ingest, clean, engineer features, validate, and optionally export the Beijing PRSA data.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
library(zoo)
library(slider)
```

## 1) Ingest and combine

```{r ingest}
data_dir <- if (!is.null(params$data_dir)) params$data_dir else "PRSA_Data"
csv_files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

stopifnot(length(csv_files) > 0)

air_raw <- purrr::map_dfr(
  csv_files,
  readr::read_csv,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  id = "source_file"
) %>%
  clean_names()

glimpse(air_raw)
```

## 2) Basic cleaning and time

```{r time-clean}
air <- air_raw %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = make_datetime(year, month, day, hour, tz = "Asia/Shanghai"),
    station = factor(station)
  ) %>%
  select(source_file, station, datetime, everything(), -no)

numeric_cols <- c("pm2_5", "pm10", "so2", "no2", "co", "o3", "temp", "pres", "dewp", "rain", "wspm")

# Interpolate within station, allow short gaps only
interp_short <- function(x) {
  zoo::na.approx(x, maxgap = 6, na.rm = FALSE)
}

air_interp <- air %>%
  arrange(station, datetime) %>%
  group_by(station) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(numeric_cols), interp_short)) %>%
  ungroup()

missing_after_interp <- air_interp %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(numeric_cols), ~ mean(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "missing_rate") %>%
  mutate(missing_pct = scales::percent(missing_rate, accuracy = 0.1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing_rate))

missing_after_interp
```

## 3) Core feature engineering

```{r feature-engineering}
simplify_wd <- function(wd) {
  case_when(
    wd %in% c("N", "NNE", "NE", "ENE") ~ "NE",
    wd %in% c("E", "ESE", "SE", "SSE") ~ "SE",
    wd %in% c("S", "SSW", "SW", "WSW") ~ "SW",
    wd %in% c("W", "WNW", "NW", "NNW") ~ "NW",
    TRUE ~ "CV"
  )
}

air_feat <- air_interp %>%
  mutate(
    month_num = month(datetime),
    season = case_when(
      month_num %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
      month_num %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
      month_num %in% 9:11 ~ "Autumn",
      TRUE ~ "Winter"
    ),
    season_year = if_else(month_num < 3, year(datetime) - 1L, year(datetime)),
    wd_simple = simplify_wd(wd)
  ) %>%
  arrange(station, datetime)

air_feat <- air_feat %>%
  group_by(station) %>%
  mutate(
    wd_run_id = cumsum(wd_simple != lag(wd_simple, default = first(wd_simple))),
    crain_24h = slider::slide_dbl(replace_na(rain, 0), sum, .before = 23, .complete = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  group_by(station, wd_run_id) %>%
  mutate(
    cws = cumsum(replace_na(wspm, 0))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

region_map <- tribble(
  ~station, ~region,
  "Dingling", "Suburban",
  "Huairou", "Suburban",
  "Changping", "Suburban",
  "Shunyi", "Suburban",
  "Aotizhongxin", "Urban",
  "Dongsi", "Urban",
  "Guanyuan", "Urban",
  "Gucheng", "Urban",
  "Nongzhanguan", "Urban",
  "Tiantan", "Urban",
  "Wanliu", "Urban",
  "Wanshouxigong", "Urban"
)

air_feat <- air_feat %>%
  left_join(region_map, by = "station") %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c("Suburban", "Urban")))

aqi_breaks <- c(-Inf, 35, 75, 115, 150, 250, Inf)
aqi_labels <- c("Good", "Moderate", "Unhealthy-SG", "Unhealthy", "Very Unhealthy", "Hazardous")

air_feat <- air_feat %>%
  mutate(
    aqi_level = cut(pm2_5, breaks = aqi_breaks, labels = aqi_labels, right = FALSE, ordered_result = TRUE)
  )

glimpse(air_feat)
```

## 4) Quick visual diagnostics

```{r visuals}
# Missing percentage by column after interpolation
missing_bar <- missing_after_interp %>%
  mutate(column = fct_reorder(column, missing_rate))

p_missing <- ggplot(missing_bar, aes(x = column, y = missing_rate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#69b3a2") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(title = "Missing share after interpolation", x = NULL, y = "Missing rate")

# Time coverage by station
coverage <- air_feat %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(datetime)) %>%
  group_by(station) %>%
  summarise(start = min(date), end = max(date), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(station = fct_reorder(station, start))

p_coverage <- ggplot(coverage, aes(y = station)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = start, xmax = end), color = "#1f78b4", linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Date coverage by station", x = "Date", y = "Station") +
  theme_minimal()

# PM2.5 distribution by season_year
p_pm25 <- air_feat %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(season_year), y = pm2_5, fill = season)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(title = "PM2.5 by seasonal year", x = "Seasonal year (Mar–Feb)", y = "PM2.5 (ug/m^3)", fill = "Season") +
  theme_minimal()

p_missing
p_coverage
p_pm25
```

## 5) Validation checks

```{r validation}
dup_check <- air_feat %>%
  count(station, datetime) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

stopifnot(nrow(dup_check) == 0)

remaining_na <- air_feat %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "na_count") %>%
  arrange(desc(na_count))

summary_snapshot <- air_feat %>%
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    stations = n_distinct(station),
    start = min(datetime, na.rm = TRUE),
    end = max(datetime, na.rm = TRUE),
    seasonal_year_min = min(season_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    seasonal_year_max = max(season_year, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

list(
  remaining_na = remaining_na,
  summary = summary_snapshot
)
```

## 6) Export

```{r export}
if (isTRUE(params$write_output)) {
  out_file <- if (!is.null(params$output_file)) params$output_file else "beijing_air_processed.csv"
  readr::write_csv(air_feat, out_file)
  cat("Saved to", out_file, "\n")
} else {
  cat("Skipping export (set params$write_output = TRUE to save)\n")
}
View(air_feat)
```
